# Kairos

> Kairos is a global opportunity discovery platform for students and young professionals, aggregating scholarships, internships, and jobs from around the world into a single searchable catalog.

Kairos helps users find and track scholarships, internships, and job opportunities across 20+ countries, with personalized match scoring based on field of study, degree level, and funding preferences.

## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://the-kairos.vercel.app/): Browse and search all opportunities
- [Opportunity Map](https://the-kairos.vercel.app/map): Explore opportunities by country
- [About](https://the-kairos.vercel.app/about): Learn about Kairos and how it works
